summary: Vibes' own site names Chipotle, KFC, and Arby's among its restaurant customers, including a quoted Chipotle director statement crediting Vibes with letting the brand "move quickly" on loyalty card delivery at scale. (Scope note: Single vendor-supplied quote of unknown date; does not confirm the relationship is still active or its current scope.)

Vibes positions itself as a Tier 1 mobile engagement platform for SMS, RCS, and mobile wallet marketing, claiming direct carrier connections via "Vibes Connect" and the most RCS agent launches of any direct-connect aggregator, with an average claimed 90x ROI for SMS customers. (Scope note: ROI and "most RCS launches" claims are vendor-reported and not independently verified.)
